notes: CORRECTION to an earlier lead: an initial search suggested Upland had filed a Form 15 to voluntarily deregister its common stock. On closer check this appears incorrect/outdated — the only Form 15 located in SEC EDGAR search results is from 2024-05-30 and covers only the expiration of Preferred Stock Purchase Rights (a tax benefit preservation plan), not common stock deregistration. The company filed a 10-Q for the period ended 2026-09-30, confirming it remains an SEC reporting company as of this pass. An undated Simply Wall St item also mentioned an up-to-$10M buyback authorization and a Carahsoft 'Master Government Aggregator' partnership; both are omitted from catalysts for lack of a confirmable date. Current share price/market cap not established.
